description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Daru Healer, adding {W}.
When Daru Healer dies, Yedora triggers, returning Daru Healer from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Daru Healer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Daru Healer's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
